source: v0: planalto federal HTML (stopgap: IA raw items not yet published). v1 addition: real IA OCR (_djvu.txt) from published RO casacivil raw items, via opf-sample + opf-bootstrap (regex pre-label) + llm-subagent audit (Phase 2.5 Path 1, docs/opf-finetune.md)
conventions: markers (art/par) exclude the trailing period — normalized for consistency across docs after the regex-baseline error finder surfaced the drift (segmenter.py). vigencia/revogacao clause spans exclude their own preceding art_marcador (tagged separately) to avoid BIOES overlap. Text quoting another norm's articles verbatim (a law amending another law) is a hard negative — never tagged as this document's own structure, matching the existing cross-reference convention.
annotation_method: v0 (federal/planalto, 6 docs): llm_subagents(shard-per-doc) -> deterministic sequential-cursor offset resolution -> opf_annotate.validate. v1 addition (ro/casacivil, 13 docs, train split only): regex_segmenter_v1 pre-label (opf-bootstrap) -> one llm_subagent per doc audits/corrects (Phase 2.5 Path 1) -> opf_annotate.from-spans (match+nth, never char-counted by the subagent) -> opf_annotate.validate + a cross-doc consistency pass (hard-negative rule + BIOES-overlap fixes) by the orchestrating session.
known_limitations: eval slice (val/test) is still v0-only: federal/planalto, clean official HTML text, no OCR noise. The 13 new v1 docs (real, noisy RO casacivil OCR) went to train only — a single-subagent audit isn't the 4-role ensemble bar this gold's eval slice requires (docs/opf-finetune.md Phase 2.5).
v1's fonte diversity is still single-fonte within RO (casacivil only) — ro/assembleia has zero published IA raw items as of this run (confirmed via list_raw_ids), so it could not be sampled

measured evidence for the ADR-0012 fine-tune trigger: the regex baseline's exact micro-F1 drops from 0.95 (v0, clean text) to 0.86 on the v1-expanded gold (0.94 overlap), driven by cue-phrase categories hit hardest by real OCR noise — ementa exact-F1 0.24, revogacao 0.33, vigencia 0.38 (overlap stays 0.94-1.00, so the regex still finds the right region, just not the exact boundary). Run `leizilla opf-regex-eval` to reproduce.
